description: This class defines a custom transition for Android animations, specifically a scale transition used during activity transitions to animate views scaling in and out.

classes.name: ScaleTransition
classes.description: A custom transition class extending Visibility to animate scaling of views during scene changes.

methods.name: createAnimation
methods.description: Creates an object animator that scales a view from startScale to endScale on both X and Y axes.

methods.name: onAppear
methods.description: Overrides the method to define the animation when a view appears, scaling from 0 to 1.

methods.name: onDisappear
methods.description: Overrides the method to define the animation when a view disappears, scaling from 1 to 0.
